english.title: Sell / give as a gift defectively deactivated weapon
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being a person who owned or claimed to own a defectively deactivated weapon, namely **(..SPECIFY WEAPON..), you sold or gave it to another person, namely **(..SPECIFY THE PERSON..)
english.legislation: Contrary to section 8A(1)(b) and (11) of the Firearms (Amendment) Act 1988.

investigatoraction.description: DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) 'Sell' includes exchange or barter, see section 8A(9) of the Firearms (Amendment) Act 1988.
(ii) For exceptions to the offence where the other person is outside the United Kingdom see section 8A(3).

other.penalty:
Either way -
Summary: maximum 6/12 months imprisonment and / or fine,
Indictment: maximum 5 years imprisonment and / or fine,

The maximum penalty on summary conviction is 6 months for offences committed before 2nd May 2002; for offences committed on or after that date it may be 6 or 12 months depending on the general limit in a magistrates’ court, see section 8A(11) of the Firearms (Amendment) Act 1988 and section 224(1) and (1A) of the Sentencing Act 2020.

Time limit for prosecutions:None
